svg.title: NNLCI: two 3 by 3 patches, one POI, a field assembled point by point
svg.desc: Schematic. LF1 and LF2 each contribute nine aligned sample locations with four variables. LF2 has a finer underlying mesh, not more input points. The 72 features enter an MLP, which predicts four variables only at the center POI. Repeat at all 801 by 801 grid locations. Field colors show the packaged HF reference as a visual stand-in, not model results. HF labels reach only the training loss.
svg.text: 3 × 3 in. One point out. Repeat over 801 × 801.
LF2 has a finer source mesh; both LF inputs still contain exactly nine locations.
Place at its coordinate; repeat for every target point
LF patches → MLP → one POI → field
